items.text: This question is about hydrogen chloride and hydrochloric acid.

items.text: a Hydrochloric acid is made when hydrogen chloride dissolves in water. Draw a dot-and-cross diagram for hydrogen chloride. (2)

items.text: b When hydrogen chloride dissolves in water an acid-base reaction occurs. The equation for this reaction is:

items.label: text

items.text: c Hydrochloric acid can be used to make chloride salts. Complete the table by stating what you would add to dilute hydrochloric acid to make each of the salts. In each case, state whether you would add it as a solid or in solution and state any other products formed. The first one has been done for you. (4)

items.label: table
items.text:
| Reagent          | Solid or solution?   |                   | Salt                | Other product   |
|------------------|----------------------|-------------------|---------------------|-----------------|
| magnesium        | solid                | hydrochloric acid | magnesium chloride  | hydrogen        |
| copper(ll) oxide |                      | hydrochloric acid | copper(ll) chloride |                 |
|                  | solution             | hydrochloric acid | sodium chloride     | water           |
|                  | solution             | hydrochloric acid | silver chloride     | nitric acid     |
